name: Alfa-Bank
note: Largest private Russian bank; title partner of the Russian Premier League (the league is branded 'Альфа-Банк РПЛ') and the league patch on Rostov's 2026-27 home shirt. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Ownership changed in 2023-2024: Fridman and Aven completed the sale of their stakes to co-founder Andrey Kosogov (FT via Kommersant and Meduza; closed 2024, no official register published), and Kosogov also bought out Khan's and Kuzmichev's stakes, making him the largest shareholder (about 41% via ABH Holdings as of March 2022). ABHH's own press releases (abhh.lu, August 2023) describe ABH Financial Limited as holding the ownership interest in Alfa-Bank Russia with a sale to Kosogov signed in February 2023 pending Cyprus approval. No state in the chain; no human-rights finding against the bank found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
